title: Step 0 · PostgreSQL and tenant isolation
Move the database to PostgreSQL 17
The product runs on PostgreSQL 17
story: As a company admin, I want YukthiX to run on PostgreSQL so that we get one database that supports row-level security for every company.
acceptance: Given a fresh environment, when docker-compose starts, then PostgreSQL 17 runs instead of SQL Server.
Given the Prisma schema, when migrations run, then one fresh PostgreSQL baseline creates every table.
Given unbounded text columns and the real ON DELETE actions, when the schema is compared with SQL Server, then no column is cut short and no delete rule is lost.
Given an org slug or email typed in another case, when it is looked up, then it still matches.

title: Existing exam-app features keep working on PostgreSQL
story: As a recruiter, I want every exam-app screen to keep working after the move so that nothing breaks for current customers.
acceptance: Given raw SQL, the seed and scripts, when they run on PostgreSQL, then they give the same results as before.
Given staff and admin search, when a user types any case, then the search is case-insensitive.
Given the recycle bin, when rows are purged, then each row is purged in its own transaction.
Given the e2e suites, when they run in one worker with AI calls offline, then they pass or assert the current behaviour.

title: Tenant isolation with forced row-level security
Every company table has forced row-level security
story: As a company admin, I want the database itself to stop any other company from reading our rows so that a coding mistake can never leak our data.
acceptance: Given any table with organization_id, when the app role reads it without a company set, then it gets no rows (fail-closed) (YX-ORG-14).
Given company A's context, when the app reads or writes company B's rows, then the database refuses (YX-ORG-14).
Given child tables like attempts, answers and results, when they are checked, then they also carry organization_id and forced RLS (YX-ORG-14).
Given a new model without organization_id or forced RLS, when CI runs rls-isolation.e2e-spec.ts, then the build fails (YX-ORG-14).

title: Company context is set per transaction
story: As a company admin, I want the company context to live only inside one database transaction so that a pooled connection can never carry another company's context.
acceptance: Given forTenant(), when a transaction opens, then the company and user are set with set_config local to that transaction (YX-ORG-14).
Given the transaction ends, when the same pooled connection is reused, then no company context remains (YX-ORG-14).
Given soft-delete queries, when they run inside forTenant(), then they keep the company filter (YX-ORG-14).

title: The app connects as a non-owner role
story: As YukthiX staff, I want the app to use a database role that cannot bypass RLS so that only migrations run with owner rights.
acceptance: Given CI, when migrations run, then they run as the owner role (YX-ORG-14).
Given CI, when the app and tests run, then they use the NOBYPASSRLS app role (YX-ORG-14).
Given a production deploy, when the README is followed, then the three database roles (owner, app login, app_runtime) are created before the first migrate deploy.

title: Security fixes found while moving to PostgreSQL
story: As a company admin, I want the issues found during the move fixed so that the new base is safe.
acceptance: Given an org webhook URL, when it is saved, then it must be a public https endpoint.
Given a code review regeneration, when it is asked for, then attempt ownership is checked first.
Given the monitoring socket, when a user joins, then permission profiles and org overrides apply (YX-SEC-05).

title: Move live customer data from SQL Server to PostgreSQL
story: As YukthiX staff, I want a tested export, load and cut-over plan so that current customers move to PostgreSQL without data loss.
acceptance: Given a copy of production, when the export and load run, then row counts match for every table.
Given the loaded data, when rls-isolation checks run, then every company sees only its own rows (YX-ORG-14).
Given the cut-over rehearsal, when it finishes, then the downtime and rollback steps are written down.

title: Step 1 · Login and security
Sessions and login protection
See and sign out my active sessions
story: As an employee, I want to see where I am signed in and sign out any session so that a lost device cannot stay signed in.
acceptance: Given I sign in, when the session is created, then it is stored server-side with device, IP, idle and absolute expiry (YX-IAM-06).
Given my session is idle longer than the limit, when I make a request, then I get 'Session expired' (YX-IAM-06).
Given Me › Security, when I click 'Sign out' on a session, then its tokens stop working at once (YX-IAM-06).
Given an admin, when they revoke a session in their company, then that user is signed out (YX-IAM-06).

title: Login history for me and for admins
story: As an HR admin, I want to see every login attempt in my company so that I can spot attacks.
acceptance: Given any sign-in attempt, when it ends, then an append-only login_events row records result, method, IP and time (YX-IAM-10).
Given Me › Security, when I open login history, then I see only my own events (YX-IAM-10).
Given Admin › Login activity, when an admin filters by method or 'unsuccessful', then they see their company's events only (YX-IAM-10).
Given a session revocation or MFA change, when it happens, then it is logged too (YX-IAM-10).

title: Account lockout the company can tune within the YukthiX floor
story: As a company admin, I want to set how many failed logins lock an account so that we stop guessing attacks without locking people out too easily.
acceptance: Given repeated failed logins, when the company limit is reached, then the account is locked for the set time (YX-IAM-07).
Given the lockout settings, when an admin enters values weaker than the YukthiX minimum, then saving is refused (YX-IAM-07).
Given a locked account, when an admin clicks 'Unlock' on Login activity, then the person can sign in again and the action is logged (YX-IAM-07, YX-IAM-10).
Given many parallel failed attempts, when they race, then the lock is applied atomically (YX-IAM-07).

title: Bot check and new-device / new-country alerts
story: As an employee, I want to be told when someone signs in to my account from a new device or country so that I can act fast.
acceptance: Given a sign-in from a new device, when it succeeds, then I get a notification (YX-IAM-07).
Given a sign-in from a new country (geo header), when it succeeds, then I get a notification (YX-IAM-07).
Given the public login page is under attack and Turnstile keys are set, when someone signs in, then a bot check is shown (YX-IAM-07).
Given the sign-in API, when an unknown email is tried, then the reply does not reveal which company exists (YX-IAM-07).

title: Passwords and company security policy
Strong passwords with a breached-password check
story: As an employee, I want the system to refuse weak or leaked passwords so that my account is hard to break.
acceptance: Given a new password shorter than 12 characters, when I save it, then it is refused (YX-IAM-08).
Given a password found in a breach list, when I set or change it, then it is refused (YX-IAM-08).
Given an existing breached password, when I sign in, then I must change it first (YX-IAM-08).
Given passwords, when stored, then they use argon2 and never expire on a timer (YX-IAM-08).

title: Company security policy page with the YukthiX minimum shown
story: As a company admin, I want one page to set MFA scope, session limits and password rules so that our company can be stricter than the YukthiX floor.
acceptance: Given Settings › Security, when I open it, then each setting shows the YukthiX minimum next to it (YX-IAM-06).
Given an idle limit above 8 h or an absolute limit above 12 h, when I save, then it is refused (YX-IAM-06).
Given MFA scope 'everyone', when saved, then every user must use two-step sign-in (YX-IAM-01).
Given a policy change, when saved, then it needs step-up and is logged (YX-IAM-02, YX-IAM-10).
Given the policy, when a request arrives, then it is enforced at sign-in and on every request (YX-IAM-06).

title: IP allow-lists for desk, admin console and API
story: As a company admin, I want to allow sign-in only from our office networks so that stolen passwords are useless elsewhere.
acceptance: Given a desk allow-list, when a staff request comes from outside it, then it is refused (YX-IAM-09).
Given an admin allow-list, when any admin-grade permission is used from outside it, then it is refused (YX-IAM-09).
Given an API allow-list, when an API key is used from outside it, then it is refused (YX-IAM-09).
Given candidate and external portals, when no list includes them, then they are not blocked (YX-IAM-09).

title: Two-step verification and step-up
Passkeys, authenticator apps and recovery codes
story: As an HR admin, I want to add a passkey or an authenticator app so that my account needs two steps to sign in.
acceptance: Given Me › Security, when I add a passkey or TOTP app, then it is saved as a factor (YX-IAM-03).
Given I enrol my first factor, when it is saved, then recovery codes are shown once and each works only once (YX-IAM-11).
Given a second sign-in step, when I use the passkey or TOTP, then the session reaches AAL2 (YX-IAM-03).
Given first-factor enrolment, when I do it, then it needs a fresh sign-in and never counts as step-up (YX-IAM-02).
evidence: PR #129 · 2fe4bbb3 · 515085cb · b1f073a8 · bccaa019 · test/mfa.e2e-spec.ts · mfa.service.spec.ts · TwoStepSection.test.tsx

title: MFA is mandatory for sensitive roles
story: As a company admin, I want people in sensitive roles to use two-step sign-in so that HR and payroll data stay safe.
acceptance: Given a user with a sensitive permission and no factor, when they use it, then it is refused until they enrol (YX-IAM-01).
Given an existing user in a sensitive role, when they sign in, then they get a 14-day grace to enrol, then it is enforced (YX-IAM-01).
Given YukthiX staff, when they sign in, then they get no grace (YX-IAM-01).
Given a role or permission-profile change, when saved, then the person's sessions end (YX-IAM-06).

title: Step-up before sensitive actions
story: As an HR admin, I want to re-verify before a sensitive action so that a left-open session cannot be misused.
acceptance: Given a step-up action, when my last AAL2 check is older than 15 minutes, then I am asked to re-verify (YX-IAM-02).
Given I re-verified within 15 minutes, when I do another step-up action, then I am not asked again (YX-IAM-02).
Given a step-up, when it succeeds, then the audit entry records it (YX-IAM-02).
Given a one-time code, when used as step-up, then it is refused (YX-IAM-03).

title: Admin MFA reset needs a second admin
story: As a company admin, I want a lost-device reset for a sensitive-role user to need a second admin so that one person cannot take over an account.
acceptance: Given a sensitive-role user lost their factors, when admin A asks for a reset, then admin B must approve (YX-IAM-11).
Given the reset is approved, when it completes, then the user's sessions end and it is logged (YX-IAM-10).
Given admin A, when they try to approve their own request, then it is refused (YX-SEC-11).
evidence: PR #129 · 515085cb · mfa.service.spec.ts · test/mfa.e2e-spec.ts · API done, screen pending: no web screen calls security/mfa-resets yet

title: One-time codes and the generic SMS channel
Sign in with a one-time code by email or mobile
story: As an employee without a work email, I want to sign in with a code sent to my verified mobile so that I can use YukthiX in the field.
acceptance: Given a verified email or mobile, when I ask for a code, then it is sent at once and expires quickly (YX-NTF-13).
Given the code message, when it is sent, then it carries only the code, its purpose and expiry, no other data (YX-NTF-04, YX-NTF-13).
Given System Admin or Payroll Admin, when they choose OTP as the only second factor, then it is refused (YX-IAM-03).
Given repeated code requests, when the per-identifier cap is reached, then more codes are refused for the hour (YX-IAM-07).

title: Connect any SMS gateway by configuration
story: As a company admin, I want to plug in our own SMS gateway, or use YukthiX's shared account, so that codes reach our people.
acceptance: Given a gateway's HTTP config, when it is saved, then the templated adapter sends through it without code changes (YX-NTF-07).
Given an SMS, when it is sent, then it uses a DLT-registered template (YX-NTF-07).
Given no valid template for the type, when a send is tried, then it falls back to email and the reason is logged (YX-NTF-07).
Given secrets, when an admin views the account, then they are write-only and never shown back.

title: SMS failover, delivery log and delivery reports
story: As a company admin, I want to see every SMS attempt and its status so that I can fix delivery problems.
acceptance: Given a failed send, when another account is set, then the message fails over to it (YX-NTF-10).
Given every attempt, when it ends, then the delivery log records status and provider id (YX-NTF-10).
Given a delivery report callback, when it arrives with a valid token, then the status is updated (YX-NTF-10).
Given an opt-out report from the provider, when it arrives, then that number is no longer used (YX-NTF-11).

title: SMS consent, metering and a monthly cap
story: As a company admin, I want SMS sent only to people who agreed and within our monthly cap so that we follow TRAI rules and control cost.
acceptance: Given no active SMS consent, when a code would go by SMS, then it goes only if the person asked for SMS (YX-NTF-14).
Given each SMS, when sent, then it is metered for the company with its parts (YX-NTF-12).
Given the monthly cap is reached, when another SMS is due, then it is not sent and the fallback is logged (YX-NTF-12).
Given an OTP SMS, when sent, then it counts toward the quota but skips quiet hours and digests (YX-NTF-13).

title: Settings › Notifications › SMS screen
story: As a company admin, I want a screen to manage SMS accounts, test a send and read the delivery log so that I don't need YukthiX support.
acceptance: Given the SMS page, when I add an account, then secrets are write-only (YX-NTF-07).
Given 'Test send', when I send to my number, then the result shows in the delivery log (YX-NTF-10).
Given a phone-width screen, when I open the log, then rows show as cards with masked numbers (YX-NTF-10).

title: WhatsApp authentication codes
story: As an employee, I want to get my sign-in code on WhatsApp so that I get it even when SMS is slow.
acceptance: Given a company WhatsApp number with an approved authentication template, when I ask for a code on WhatsApp, then it is sent at once (YX-NTF-13, YX-NTF-07).
Given no approved template, when a WhatsApp code is due, then it falls back to SMS or email and logs why (YX-NTF-07).
Given I never opted in or asked on WhatsApp, when a code is due, then WhatsApp is not used (YX-NTF-14).

title: Single sign-on
Several identity providers per company
story: As a company admin, I want to connect Google, Microsoft Entra and SAML providers so that each email domain signs in with its own provider.
acceptance: Given several providers, when each maps its own email domains, then a user is sent to the right one (YX-IAM-04).
Given Google, Entra or a generic OIDC issuer, when a user signs in, then the OIDC flow completes (YX-IAM-04).
Given any provider change, when saved, then every company admin gets an email (YX-IAM-10).
Given a generic issuer, when saved, then its discovery URLs are DNS-checked and pinned (YX-IAM-04).

title: Create users on first SSO sign-in (JIT)
story: As a company admin, I want new staff to get an account on their first SSO sign-in so that IT doesn't create each one.
acceptance: Given an allowed domain, when a new person signs in by SSO, then a user is created with the default role (YX-IAM-05).
Given a domain not allowed, when someone signs in, then no user is created (YX-IAM-05).
Given JIT rules, when a user is created, then a sensitive role is never given automatically (YX-IAM-05).
Given the provider asserts MFA with fixed values, when the user signs in, then the session counts as AAL2 (YX-IAM-01).

title: SSO-only with break-glass admins
story: As a company admin, I want to switch off passwords for normal users so that everyone must use our identity provider.
acceptance: Given SSO-only on, when a normal user tries a password, then it fails (YX-IAM-04).
Given fewer than 2 break-glass admins, when I turn on SSO-only, then saving is refused (YX-IAM-04).
Given a break-glass admin signs in with a password and MFA, when it succeeds, then all admins are alerted (YX-IAM-04).
Given SSO-only is turned on or a provider is disabled, when saved, then sessions opened through it end (YX-IAM-06).

title: SSO hardening from the security review
story: As a company admin, I want our SSO to resist known attacks so that nobody can sign in as our staff through another provider.
acceptance: Given a provider, when it asserts an email outside its own domains, then sign-in is refused (YX-IAM-04).
Given the SSO code in the callback, when it is redeemed, then it is device-bound, in the URL fragment and used once (YX-IAM-04).
Given a replayed SAML assertion, when it arrives, then the atomic replay check refuses it (YX-IAM-04).
Given an IdP change, when it is made, then it needs user-admin rights (YX-IAM-05).

title: Sign in without a company code
Email-first sign-in with a company picker
story: As an employee, I want to sign in with just my work email so that I never need to know a company code.
acceptance: Given my email belongs to one company, when I enter it and my password, then I sign in to that company (YX-IAM-04).
Given my email is in several companies, when the password matches more than one, then a company picker shows only those (YX-IAM-07).
Given 0 or 1 matching accounts, when I sign in, then the response takes about the same time (YX-IAM-07).
Given the picker, when I choose, then a one-use selection token tied to my device and valid 2 minutes completes sign-in (YX-IAM-07).

title: Company from the web address or a remembered company
story: As an employee, I want my company's own address or my last company to be remembered so that sign-in is one step.
acceptance: Given a company subdomain under YX_BASE_DOMAIN, when I open it, then the sign-in page is for that company (YX-IAM-04).
Given I signed in before on this device, when I return, then my company is remembered and can be changed (YX-IAM-04).
Given forgot password, when I enter my work email only, then a reset link is sent without asking for a company (YX-IAM-08).

title: Verify company email domains by DNS TXT
story: As a company admin, I want to prove we own our email domain so that only verified domains send people to our SSO.
acceptance: Given a domain, when I add it, then the TXT record to publish is shown (YX-IAM-04).
Given 'Check record', when the TXT record is found, then the domain is marked verified (YX-IAM-04).
Given an unverified domain, when someone signs in email-first, then it does not route them to our provider (YX-IAM-04).

title: Staff accounts never show in the company picker
story: As YukthiX staff, I want my staff account kept out of the company sign-in so that staff only sign in through the locked-down console path with hardware keys.
acceptance: Given a staff account with the same email and password as a company account, when that email signs in email-first, then no 'YukthiX' choice is shown (YX-SECOPS-08).
Given a staff account, when it tries to sign in on a company page, then it is refused with a neutral message (YX-SECOPS-08).
Given the console sign-in path, when a staff member signs in, then a hardware security key is required (YX-SECOPS-08, YX-IAM-01).
evidence: PR #129 · W-005 · auth.service.ts · test/email-first-sign-in.e2e-spec.ts (staff never in the picker, refused on the company path) · criterion 3 (hardware key for staff) still open, see D-074

title: Re-check verified email domains regularly
story: As a company admin, I want verified domains re-checked so that a lapsed domain stops routing people to our SSO.
acceptance: Given a verified domain, when the scheduled DNS re-check runs, then it still needs the TXT record (YX-IAM-04).
Given the record is missing on two checks in a row, when the job runs, then the domain is marked unverified and admins are emailed (YX-IAM-04, YX-IAM-10).
Given an unverified domain, when someone signs in email-first, then it no longer routes to SSO (YX-IAM-04).
evidence: PR #129 · DOMAIN_RECHECK_CRON · lapse after 3 misses, admins emailed, audit identity_provider.domain_lapsed · test/email-first-sign-in.e2e-spec.ts (domain re-check)

title: Continue with Google or Microsoft
story: As an employee, I want to sign in with my Google or Microsoft account so that I do not need a YukthiX password.
acceptance: Given the company allows Google (or Microsoft), when I click "Continue with Google", then I go to YukthiX's own sign-in app and come back signed in to my company (YX-IAM-07).
Given the switch is off or no YukthiX account matches, when I come back, then one neutral message shows: "We couldn't sign you in with that account. Try another way, or ask your admin." (YX-IAM-07).
Given a staff account, when it tries Google or Microsoft on the company page, then it is refused with the same message (YX-SECOPS-08).
Given accounts in more than one company, when I come back, then the company picker shows (YX-IAM-07).
Given no OAuth app is configured, when the sign-in page loads, then the button is hidden.
evidence: social.controller.ts · social-sign-in.ts · test/social-sign-in.e2e-spec.ts · seen live with the mock IdP 8 Oct 2026

title: One lock answer on every sign-in path (W-016)
story: As a company admin, I want a locked email or number to get the same answer on every sign-in path so that an attacker cannot route around the lock.
acceptance: Given a locked identifier, when it tries any path (with or without a company, password, code, Google, Microsoft or passkey), then the same 429 "Too many tries" answer with the wait time comes back (YX-IAM-07).
Given a successful sign-in, when it completes, then the identifier lock clears (YX-IAM-07).
Given a break-glass account, when it signs in, then the identifier lock does not apply (YX-IAM-04).
Given an admin unlock, when it completes, then the identifier lock clears too (YX-IAM-07).

title: Login and security screens
YukthiX sign-in, second step and Me › Security screens
story: As an employee, I want clear sign-in and security screens so that I can manage my factors, sessions and history myself.
acceptance: Given /yx/sign-in, when I sign in, then the second step and step-up prompt use the YukthiX design (YX-IAM-02).
Given Me › Security, when I open it, then I see passkeys, TOTP, recovery codes, sessions and login history (YX-IAM-06, YX-IAM-10).
Given Admin › Login activity, when an admin opens it, then failed-login spikes and sessions are listed (YX-IAM-10).
Given a phone width, when a table is shown, then it turns into cards without page side-scrolling.
evidence: PR #129 · d6ea28d4 · 111c9d4a · 07fad7b4 · e82cd72a · yx-pages.test.tsx · auth.test.tsx · SecondFactorForm.test.tsx

title: Change password from My security
story: As an employee, I want to change my password from My security so that a leaked password stops working everywhere else.
acceptance: Given My security, when I type my current and new password, then the new one must pass the password rules and the breached-password check (YX-IAM-08).
Given the change succeeds, when it completes, then every other session is signed out, this one stays, and I get an email (YX-IAM-06, YX-IAM-10).
Given a wrong current password, when I submit, then "Your current password is wrong. Try again." shows and nothing changes (YX-IAM-08).
evidence: users.service.ts changePassword · me-security.tsx PasswordCard · seen live 8 Oct 2026

title: Rename a passkey
story: As an employee, I want to name my passkeys so that I can tell my phone from my laptop.
acceptance: Given a passkey in My security, when I click Rename and confirm it's you, then the new name shows in the list (YX-IAM-02).
Given the rename, when it completes, then it is logged as mfa.renamed (YX-IAM-10).

title: Copy or download recovery codes
story: As an employee, I want to copy or download my recovery codes so that I do not lose them.
acceptance: Given new recovery codes, when they show, then "Copy codes" and "Download" save them (YX-IAM-11).
Given the codes, when I have not ticked "I have saved my recovery codes", then Continue stays off (YX-IAM-11).
Given the download, when it runs, then it happens in the browser and the server keeps no copy (YX-IAM-11).
evidence: kit.tsx RecoveryCodes · auth.test.tsx "downloads the recovery codes"

title: Verify or remove a mobile number in My security
story: As an employee, I want to verify my mobile number myself so that I can get sign-in codes by text.
acceptance: Given My security, when I type a number and click "Text me a code", then a code is texted and "Verify number" confirms it (YX-IAM-03).
Given a verified number, when I open My security, then it reads "Verified. Used for sign-in codes where your company allows them." (YX-IAM-03).
Given Remove, when I confirm, then the number is removed, logged and I am emailed (YX-IAM-10).
evidence: me-security.tsx MobileCard · POST auth/otp/mobile · mfa.service.ts removeMobile · auth.test.tsx

title: Login activity filters: result, method, person and dates
story: As a company admin, I want to filter login activity so that I can find one person's or one day's sign-ins fast.
acceptance: Given Login activity, when I set Result, Method, Person or a date range, then only matching events of my company show (YX-IAM-10).
Given 20 or more failed attempts in the last 24 hours, when the page loads, then a warning banner with "Show failed attempts" shows (YX-IAM-10).
Given the "Signed in now" tab, when the page loads, then the tab shows the session count (YX-IAM-06).
evidence: login-activity.tsx · tables.tsx · GET security/login-events · seen live 8 Oct 2026

title: Unlock a person with a reason, step-up and an email
story: As a company admin, I want to unlock a locked person with a written reason so that every unlock is explained and the person knows.
acceptance: Given a Failed row with the "Locked the account" badge, when I click Unlock, then a reason of at least 10 characters and step-up are needed (YX-IAM-02, YX-IAM-07).

Given the unlock, when it completes, then the account and identifier locks clear, audit account.unlocked and an "Unlocked by admin" row are written, and the person gets "Your YukthiX account was unlocked" (YX-IAM-07, YX-IAM-10).
Given a lock that is over, when I look at the row, then no Unlock is offered (YX-IAM-07).
evidence: sessions.service.ts unlockAccount · POST security/users/:id/unlock · tables.tsx UnlockDialog · unit test "unlocks a locked person only with a reason"

title: Step 1 security review and follow-ups
Fix every finding of the step 1 security review
story: As a company admin, I want the independent review's findings fixed before release so that login is safe on day one.
acceptance: Given a sign-in, when an org does not exist, then the reply gives no hint (YX-IAM-07).
Given YukthiX super admins, when they enrol MFA, then only device-bound security keys are accepted (YX-SECOPS-08).
Given the dependency audit gate, when CI runs, then no high or critical advisory is open (YX-SECOPS-04).
Given the monitoring socket, when the roster ticks, then each socket is re-validated (YX-IAM-06).

title: Identity re-verification as a recovery route
story: As an HR admin who lost every factor, I want to recover by re-verifying my identity so that I am not stuck when no second admin is available.
acceptance: Given a sensitive-role user with no factors, when no second admin can approve, then they can recover by identity re-verification (YX-IAM-11).
Given the re-verification passes, when recovery completes, then old factors and sessions are revoked and all admins are alerted (YX-IAM-11, YX-IAM-10).
Given a sensitive-role account with no factor, when someone uses the email reset link, then it does not bypass MFA enrolment (YX-IAM-11).

title: Passkey-only sign-in
story: As an employee, I want to sign in with only my passkey so that I don't need a password at all.
acceptance: Given a registered discoverable passkey, when I choose 'Sign in with passkey', then I sign in without a password at AAL2 (YX-IAM-03).
Given a company with SSO-only on, when a normal user tries passkey-only, then the company rule applies (YX-IAM-04).
Given the sign-in, when it ends, then a login event records method 'passkey' (YX-IAM-10).

acceptance: Given role templates, when a company starts, then Employee, Manager, HR Admin, HR Executive, Payroll Admin and the others exist (YX-SEC-02).
Given business logic, when it checks access, then it checks permissions only, never role names (YX-SEC-02).
Given a template, when edited, then it can be restored to the YukthiX version (YX-SEC-02).
Given exam-app users, when migrated, then org_admin maps to System Admin + HR Admin and profiles become custom roles (YX-SEC-02).

title: Several role grants per user, each with a scope
story: As a company admin, I want to give one person HR Admin for one entity and Payroll for another so that access matches their job.
acceptance: Given a user, when granted several roles, then each grant has its own scope and optional dates (YX-SEC-03).
Given several grants, when access is checked, then rights are the union of grants (YX-SEC-03).
Given an auditor grant, when its end date passes, then it expires on its own (YX-SEC-15).
Given the User.role string, when grants exist, then guards use grants (YX-SEC-03).

title: Implicit Employee, Manager and Department-head grants
story: As a manager, I want my access to follow my team automatically so that HR doesn't assign it by hand.
acceptance: Given an employee, when active, then they hold Employee @ self (YX-SEC-04).
Given anyone with reports, when the assignment changes, then Manager @ team is recomputed (YX-SEC-04).
Given a department head, when set, then they get Department head @ department subtree (YX-SEC-04).
Given view vs approve, when defaults apply, then view covers the whole subtree and approve only direct reports (P02 Q2) (YX-SEC-04).

title: One visibility service for every read
story: As an employee, I want nobody to reach my record by guessing an id so that my data is safe.
acceptance: Given any list, record, report or export, when read, then it passes through the visibility service (YX-SEC-05).
Given an employee, when they fetch another employee's record by id, then they get nothing (YX-SEC-05).
Given counts and charts, when shown, then they include only visible records (YX-SEC-05).
Given a manager transferred out, when the next day comes, then they lose access to the team's new records (YX-SEC-06).

title: Field registry with sensitivity classes
story: As an HR admin, I want each field labelled Public to Special so that the server hides or masks what a role may not see.
acceptance: Given every personal field, when registered, then it has a class: Public, Internal, Personal, Confidential or Special (YX-SEC-07).
Given a role × class level hidden, masked, read, edit or edit_with_approval, when a read happens, then the server redacts (YX-SEC-07).
Given a write to a field the role cannot edit, when sent, then the server rejects it (YX-SEC-07).
Given exports and API responses, when produced, then the same rules apply (YX-SEC-07).

title: Masked values with an audited reveal
story: As a payroll admin, I want to reveal a masked bank account when needed so that I can work, with a record of each look.
acceptance: Given a masked value, when I have reveal rights and click 'Show', then it is shown (YX-SEC-07).
Given the reveal, when done, then the audit records who, whose, which field and when (YX-SEC-09).
Given Aadhaar, when shown to anyone without employee.aadhaar.view, then only the last 4 show (YX-SEC-08).

title: Role risk check and effective-access preview
story: As a company admin, I want a warning before I save a risky role so that I don't give too much access by mistake.
acceptance: Given a role with Confidential access over many people or prepare + approve, when saved, then warnings show with an effective-access preview (YX-SEC-18).
Given I save past the warnings, when confirmed, then it is audited and other admins are notified (YX-SEC-18).
Given hard limits (restricted areas, self-approval, Aadhaar audit, directory limits), when someone tries to grant past them, then it is not possible (YX-SEC-18).
Given a System Admin who grants themselves an HR role, when saved, then other admins are notified (YX-SEC-18).

title: Approval for bank, PAN and legal-name changes
story: As an employee, I want to request a change of bank account, PAN or legal name with proof so that it is checked before payroll uses it.
acceptance: Given a change to bank account, PAN, legal name or statutory address, when I submit it, then it needs approval with an old → new diff and proof (YX-SEC-13).
Given the change is approved, when it applies, then the old contact is notified (YX-SEC-13).
Given a new bank account, when approved, then payouts use it only after the cooling period (YX-SEC-13).
Given Personal fields like personal phone, when I edit them, then they save directly (YX-SEC-07).

title: No self-approval anywhere
story: As a company admin, I want nobody to approve their own request or role grant so that there is always a second pair of eyes.
acceptance: Given any request, when the requester or a proxy who raised it tries to approve, then it is refused (YX-SEC-11, YX-SEC-27).
Given a role grant, when the grantee tries to approve it, then it is refused (YX-SEC-11).
Given a role grant with Confidential access, when made, then it is an approvable change (YX-SEC-11).

title: Exports and breakdowns hide small groups
story: As an employee, I want salary breakdowns of tiny groups hidden so that my pay can't be worked out from a report.
acceptance: Given a breakdown of Confidential or Special data with fewer than the threshold (default 5), when a viewer without individual access opens it, then it shows 'suppressed' (YX-SEC-14).
Given the threshold, when an admin sets it, then it must be between 3 and 10 (YX-SEC-14).
Given a viewer with individual-level access, when they open it, then the figures show (YX-SEC-14).

title: 2e · People and Settings screens wired
People screens wired: directory, org chart, team, probation, bulk changes
story: As an HR admin, I want the People screens to use real data so that I can run day-to-day HR in YukthiX.
acceptance: Given each People page, when opened, then it loads from the /api/v1/people routes (YX-SEC-05).
Given a user without the permission, when navigation renders, then the page is not shown and the API still refuses (YX-SEC-01).
Given each wired page, when scan-dead-buttons runs, then it finds 0 dead buttons.
evidence: feat/yukthix-org · 7c246268 (history, changes) · uncommitted: people/directory, screens/workforce, orgchart.tsx, history-kit.tsx

title: Employee record workspace screen
story: As an HR admin, I want the employee record screen wired so that I can open any person and see every section I may see.
acceptance: Given the record, when opened, then each section loads and hides what my role may not see (YX-SEC-07).
Given the Job section, when opened, then it shows the P06 timeline with a 'Change' action (YX-HIS-11).
Given masked fields, when I may reveal, then 'Show' is offered and audited (YX-SEC-09).

title: Settings › Roles & access screens
story: As a company admin, I want screens to manage roles and grants so that I control access without support.
acceptance: Given Roles & access, when opened, then templates, permissions by module and a field-class matrix show (YX-SEC-02).
Given a user's access tab, when opened, then grants with scope and dates and an effective-access preview show (YX-SEC-03, YX-SEC-18).
Given 'who has this role', when clicked, then holders are listed.

title: Entity and period switcher on every aggregate screen
story: As an HR admin in a group company, I want every summary to say which entities and period it covers so that I never read the wrong company's numbers.
acceptance: Given the app shell, when it loads, then the entity switcher defaults to all entities I may see, never a hidden default (YX-ORG-13).
Given any aggregate screen, when shown, then it states its scope: entity · location · period (YX-ORG-13).
Given I narrow the scope, when I move to another aggregate screen, then the same scope applies and is shown (YX-ORG-13).

title: Company chooses directory fields
story: As a company admin, I want to choose which fields colleagues see in the directory so that it fits our culture and privacy.
acceptance: Given directory settings, when opened, then only Public, Internal and allow-listed Personal fields can be chosen (YX-SEC-17).
Given Confidential or Special fields, when listed, then they cannot be selected (YX-SEC-17).
Given an employee hides their birthday or personal phone, when colleagues search, then it is hidden whatever the company setting (YX-SEC-17).

title: Step 2 independent security review
Independent security review of step 2 and fixes
story: As the founder, I want an independent review of step 2 with every finding fixed so that the people core is safe before the PR.
acceptance: Given the step 2 branch, when reviewed, then cross-company access, id guessing and field leaks are tested (YX-ORG-14, YX-SEC-05, YX-SEC-07).
Given each finding, when fixed, then a test proves it and the full test run is green.
Given the review is done, when the PR opens stacked on #130, then the report lists what was fixed and what was accepted.

title: Later steps · rules from the step 0–2 docs
Step 3 · YukthiX staff access and support
Support sessions the company approves
story: As a company admin, I want YukthiX support to see our data only in a session we approve so that staff never have standing access.
acceptance: Given a support request, when a company admin approves it, then a session opens for a fixed window (default 24 h, max 72 h) with a reason (YX-SEC-20).
Given a support session, when staff read data, then restricted areas are denied and Confidential/Special are masked by default (YX-SEC-20, YX-SEC-10).
Given the window ends, when time passes, then access ends on its own (YX-SEC-15).
Given every staff action, when done, then it is audited and listed for the company's admins (YX-SEC-20).

title: Staff elevation needs a second person
story: As YukthiX staff, I want just-in-time production access approved by a colleague so that no one holds standing admin rights.
acceptance: Given a staff member, when they ask for production elevation, then a second staff member must approve and it auto-expires (YX-SECOPS-08).
Given staff sign-in, when done, then only hardware security keys are accepted (YX-SECOPS-08).
Given staff actions, when a month ends, then they are listed for the monthly review (YX-SECOPS-08).

title: Recover a staff account that lost its keys
story: As YukthiX staff, I want a safe recovery when I lose my security keys so that I am not locked out for good.
acceptance: Given a staff member with no working key, when they ask for recovery, then two other staff must approve (YX-IAM-11, YX-SECOPS-08).
Given recovery, when completed, then old keys are revoked and the action is audited (YX-IAM-10).
Given staff enrolment, when done, then two keys are registered (YX-SECOPS-08).

title: Proctor-service grant per slot
story: As a company admin, I want YukthiX proctors to see only the sessions they watch, only during the slot, so that proctoring doesn't open our data.
acceptance: Given the proctoring add-on opt-in, when a proctor is assigned a slot, then a grant covers only that slot's sessions and time (YX-SEC-23).
Given the slot ends, when time passes, then the grant expires (YX-SEC-23).
Given MFA or confidentiality terms are missing, when a grant is due, then it is not issued (YX-SEC-23).
Given every view, when made, then it is audited and listed for the company's admins (YX-SEC-23).

title: Shared SMS account moves to the platform console
story: As YukthiX staff, I want the shared SMS account managed in the platform console so that companies only see their own accounts.
acceptance: Given the platform console, when staff open channel accounts, then the shared SMS account is managed there (YX-NTF-12).
Given a company, when it opens Settings › SMS, then it sees usage of the shared account but not its secrets (YX-NTF-12).
Given the monthly cap, when counted, then the month follows each company's time zone (YX-NTF-12).

title: Step 3b · Restricted areas
Restricted cases visible only to their members
story: As an IC member, I want POSH and other restricted cases visible only to appointed members so that complainants are protected.
acceptance: Given a POSH, disciplinary, grievance, whistleblower or medical case, when someone not a member queries it, then the database returns no rows (YX-SEC-10).
Given a company admin or YukthiX support without membership, when they run a report, then the cases are not included (YX-SEC-10).
Given a restricted area, when shown, then it has a lock badge and member list (YX-SEC-10).

title: Step 4 · Host postings
Deputation, secondment and client-site postings
story: As an HR admin, I want to post someone to a host entity or client site so that their holidays, PT state and geofence follow where they work.
acceptance: Given a posting on the assignment, when saved, then the employing entity does not change (YX-ORG-21, YX-EMP-07).
Given a host location, when set, then holiday calendar, PT state and geofence come from it for those dates (YX-ORG-21, YX-EMP-07).
Given a recharge flag, when set, then the person is listed in the monthly recharge report (YX-ORG-21, YX-EMP-07).
Given start and end, when made, then they are dated changes with an impact preview (YX-HIS-11).

title: Step 5 · Payroll-linked history and duties
Corrections into processed payroll
story: As a payroll admin, I want past corrections that touch paid months to come to me and flow as arrears so that issued payslips never change.
acceptance: Given a change reaching a processed payroll, when sent, then a Payroll Admin approval step is added (YX-HIS-12).
Given the correction is approved, when the next run happens, then arrears or recoveries are computed per month with the reason (YX-HIS-08, YX-ORG-10).
Given issued payslips, when a correction applies, then they are never altered (YX-HIS-08).

title: Payroll runs freeze their inputs
story: As a payroll admin, I want each run to store the inputs it used so that any payslip can be reproduced later.
acceptance: Given a payroll run, when computed, then the as-on result and segments per employee are stored with the rule-pack version (YX-HIS-09).
Given a later correction, when a past payslip is reproduced, then it matches the issued one (YX-HIS-09).
Given the frozen inputs, when an auditor opens a payslip, then the rule-pack version used is shown (YX-HIS-09).

title: Mid-period change policy
story: As a payroll admin, I want to choose how a mid-month change is split so that pay follows our policy.
acceptance: Given a change type, when the company picks segments, cut-off day N or next month + arrears, then payroll follows it (YX-HIS-13).
Given statutory items, when computed, then they use the legal basis whatever the policy (YX-HIS-13).
Given a salary revision on 15 Sep with segments, when September runs, then two segments are paid (YX-HIS-13).

title: Statutory defaults per employment type
story: As a payroll admin, I want PF, ESI, PT, LWF, bonus and gratuity defaults to come from the employment type so that statutory treatment is right from day one.
acceptance: Given an employment-type category, when an employee joins, then default applicability comes from P07 data, never code (YX-ORG-20).
Given a default the law leaves open, when the company overrides it, then it is allowed and stored as a dated flag (YX-ORG-20).
Given a statute the law makes mandatory or excluded, when someone overrides it, then it is blocked (YX-ORG-20).

title: Payroll maker and checker are different people
story: As a company admin, I want payroll runs, bank files and statutory payments approved by someone other than the preparer so that fraud is hard.
acceptance: Given two or more approvers for an entity, when the preparer tries to approve, then the button is disabled with a reason (YX-SEC-12).
Given only one eligible user, when they self-approve, then a reason is required and the System Admin is notified (YX-SEC-12).
Given the approval, when done, then step-up is asked (YX-IAM-02).

title: Fast bank fix after a returned salary
story: As a payroll admin, I want a returned salary re-paid quickly to a corrected account so that the employee isn't left without pay.
acceptance: Given a returned payment, when a new account is approved by a checker other than the maker and a penny drop succeeds, then the cooling period is waived (YX-SEC-25).
Given the fast fix, when applied, then the employee and old contact are still notified (YX-SEC-25).
Given the maker approves their own entry or the penny drop fails, when tried, then the normal cooling period applies (YX-SEC-25, YX-SEC-13).

title: Employees see only their own rows in statutory registers
story: As an employee, I want PF, ESI and tax registers to show only my row so that colleagues' data stays private.
acceptance: Given an employee-role user, when they open a PF or ESI register, then only their own row shows (YX-SEC-16).
Given an HR Executive, when they open it, then identifiers are masked (YX-SEC-16, YX-SEC-07).
Given an employee guesses another row id in the API, when they call it, then nothing is returned (YX-SEC-16, YX-SEC-05).

title: Inter-entity transfer continuity checklist
story: As a payroll admin, I want a checklist on every inter-entity transfer so that UAN, ESI, Form 12B, loans and leave move correctly.
acceptance: Given an inter-entity transfer, when approved, then a checklist opens: UAN, ESI IP, Form 12B, declarations, loans, leave ledger, gratuity (YX-EMP-08).
Given open items, when payroll pre-flight runs, then they are shown (YX-EMP-08).
Given gratuity paid at transfer, when final exit comes, then the exemption already used is carried so the lifetime cap holds (YX-EMP-08).

title: Before the pilot · security programme
Per-company data keys and encryption
story: As a company admin, I want our Confidential and Special data encrypted with our own data key so that a leak of one company's key never exposes others.
acceptance: Given Confidential and Special fields, when stored, then they use envelope encryption with a per-company key from a cloud KMS (YX-SECOPS-01).
Given keys, when a year passes, then they are rotated (YX-SECOPS-01).
Given any connection, when made, then TLS 1.2+ with HSTS is used (YX-SECOPS-01).

title: Bring your own key (BYOK)
story: As a company admin, I want to connect our own key in Azure, AWS or Google so that we control access to our data.
acceptance: Given a customer-managed key, when connected, then YukthiX gets wrap / unwrap only and data keys are wrapped by it (YX-SECOPS-11).
Given connecting or rotating, when started, then the screen explains that revoking makes data unreadable and asks for typed confirmation (YX-SECOPS-11).
Given key health checks, when access fails, then admins are alerted; every key operation is logged (YX-SECOPS-11).

title: Deleting a company destroys its keys
story: As a company admin, I want our data unreadable after we leave so that old backups can't expose us.
acceptance: Given a deleted company, when the grace period ends, then its data keys are destroyed and recorded (YX-SECOPS-02).
Given an old backup, when restored, then the company's Special fields cannot be decrypted (YX-SECOPS-02).
Given the key destruction, when done, then a crypto-shredding record is kept with the date (YX-SECOPS-02).

title: Secrets in a secrets manager
story: As YukthiX staff, I want all secrets in a secrets manager with rotation so that no secret sits in code or images.
acceptance: Given database, API and partner credentials, when deployed, then they come only from the secrets manager (YX-SECOPS-03).
Given a secret in code, when CI runs gitleaks, then the build fails (YX-SECOPS-03).
Given the rotation schedule, when due, then secrets are rotated (YX-SECOPS-03).

title: Secure-development gates in CI
story: As YukthiX staff, I want CI to block releases with serious findings so that known holes never ship.
acceptance: Given CI, when it runs, then dependency scan, SAST, secret scan, container and IaC scans run and an SBOM is made per release (YX-SECOPS-04).
Given staging, when a release is prepared, then DAST runs (YX-SECOPS-04).
Given an open Critical or High finding, when a release is tried, then it is blocked unless formally risk-accepted (YX-SECOPS-04).

title: Vulnerability tracker and pen test
story: As YukthiX staff, I want every finding tracked against an SLA and a pen test before the pilot so that buyers can trust us.
acceptance: Given a finding, when triaged, then its due date follows the SLA: Critical 72 h, High 14 d, Medium 45 d, Low 90 d (YX-SECOPS-05).
Given the payroll pilot, when it is near, then an independent pen test is done and its findings tracked (YX-SECOPS-06).
Given a major architecture change, when it ships, then a new pen test is scheduled (YX-SECOPS-06).

title: Incident response and breach notices
story: As a company admin, I want YukthiX to tell us fast about any incident that affects us so that we can meet our own duties.
acceptance: Given a written plan with severities and roles, when an incident is found, then CERT-In is told within 6 hours where reportable (YX-SECOPS-07).
Given an affected company, when the incident is confirmed, then it is told within 24 hours and updated until closed (YX-SECOPS-07).
Given every incident, when closed, then a post-mortem is written (YX-SECOPS-07).

title: One-click breach containment
story: As a company owner, I want one 'contain' action during a breach so that every session, key and payout is frozen at once.
acceptance: Given 'contain' with a reason and step-up, when used, then sessions, API keys, OAuth and partner grants are revoked and MFA is forced (YX-SECOPS-12).
Given containment, when someone changes a bank account, runs a bulk export or releases a payout, then it is blocked with a clear message and a banner shows (YX-SECOPS-12).
Given lifting containment, when done, then it needs a second person and both actions are audited (YX-SECOPS-12).
Given containment starts, when saved, then the DPDP / CERT-In clock record opens (YX-SECOPS-07).

title: Sub-processor checks and change notice
story: As a company admin, I want to know which sub-processors handle our data and get notice of changes so that we can object in time.
acceptance: Given a new sub-processor, when onboarded, then it is security-assessed first and yearly after (YX-SECOPS-09).
Given the sub-processor list, when published, then it is public (YX-SECOPS-09).
Given a change, when planned, then companies are told 30 days ahead (YX-SECOPS-09).

title: ISO 27001 controls with continuous evidence
story: As the founder, I want controls mapped once and evidence collected all the time so that ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits are easy.
acceptance: Given the control set, when mapped, then each control points to its evidence source (YX-SECOPS-10).
Given the compliance tool, when it runs, then evidence is collected continuously, not per audit (YX-SECOPS-10).
Given public launch, when reached, then ISO 27001 certification is in place (YX-SECOPS-10).

title: SCIM provisioning and fast deprovisioning
story: As a company admin, I want our identity provider to create and disable users so that leavers lose access within minutes.
acceptance: Given a SCIM token for Entra, Okta or Google, when users sync, then they are created and updated (YX-IAM-05).
Given the IdP disables a user, when SCIM sends active=false, then all their sessions end within 5 minutes (YX-IAM-05).
Given a linked employee, when disabled, then HR's exit checklist is flagged, not auto-exited (YX-IAM-05).
Given a provider is disabled, when saved, then sessions opened through it end (YX-IAM-05).

title: Privacy programme · DPDP readiness
Versioned legal documents and acceptances
story: As a company admin, I want terms and notices versioned with every acceptance recorded so that we can prove consent.
acceptance: Given a legal document, when published, then it is versioned per locale (YX-SEC-28).
Given an acceptance or withdrawal, when made, then an append-only row records who, version, when, IP and device (YX-SEC-28).
Given a material change, when published, then users must re-accept before continued use (YX-SEC-28).
Given privacy.notice.publish, when a user lacks it, then they cannot publish the company notice (YX-SEC-28).

title: Privacy officer with a public contact
story: As a company admin, I want to name our privacy officer so that people know whom to contact.
acceptance: Given no privacy-officer contact, when someone publishes a privacy notice, then it is refused (YX-SEC-29).
Given the contact, when a notice is published, then it is printed in the notice and the contact page (YX-SEC-29).
Given the Privacy officer role template, when granted, then it holds the privacy request, register and breach permissions (YX-SEC-29).

title: Data-subject request tracker
story: As a privacy officer, I want every access, correction and erasure request tracked with a due date so that we always answer in time.
acceptance: Given a request, when logged, then identity is verified and an SLA due date within the legal maximum is set (YX-SEC-30).
Given the due date nears, when not closed, then reminders and escalation are sent (YX-SEC-30).
Given an erasure, when done, then data not under retention is deleted or anonymised and the reply lists what was kept and why (YX-SEC-30).

title: Requests and consent per person across all roles
story: As an ex-employee who is now a candidate, I want one access request to cover everything about me so that I don't ask each part separately.
acceptance: Given an access request, when run, then the export covers every role of the person and lists them (YX-SEC-36).
Given an erasure, when decided, then each role is checked against its own retention; kept records keep the name and PAN they need (YX-SEC-36).
Given a consent withdrawal, when made, then it applies to every role using that purpose (YX-SEC-36).

title: DPIA register, record of processing and retention schedule
story: As a privacy officer, I want registers that fill themselves from enabled features so that we stay ready for the regulator.
acceptance: Given a higher-risk feature, when enabled, then the user is prompted to adopt a starter DPIA (YX-SEC-31).
Given enabled modules, when the record of processing is opened, then it is seeded and exportable (YX-SEC-31).
Given retention values, when edited, then they stay within the legal minimum and range and the public page is regenerated (YX-SEC-31).

title: Breach records with legal clocks
story: As a privacy officer, I want a breach record to start the legal clocks so that we never miss a deadline.
acceptance: Given a breach recorded at 10:00, when saved, then Board and affected-person notices are due at once and a detailed Board report within 72 h (YX-SEC-32).
Given a YukthiX incident affecting the company, when marked, then a linked breach record is created in the company (YX-SEC-32).
Given GDPR applies, when recorded, then the 72 h authority clock is added (YX-SEC-32).

title: DPDP Rules dates and consent-manager adapter
story: As a privacy officer, I want each DPDP duty to show the date it applies from so that we know what is live.
acceptance: Given DPDP milestones, when stored, then they are dated rule data (YX-SEC-34).
Given Nov 2026, when it arrives, then the consent-manager adapter can accept and report consents (YX-SEC-34).
Given 13 May 2027, when it arrives, then every main duty is live (YX-SEC-34).

title: Plain-language notices, one-year logs and erasure notice
story: As an employee, I want a privacy notice that lists each purpose in plain words so that I understand how my data is used.
acceptance: Given a notice, when generated, then it is itemised per purpose with data items, withdrawal, rights and complaint route (YX-SEC-35).
Given processing and traffic logs, when kept, then they stay at least 1 year (YX-SEC-35).
Given an inactive-user erasure under the Rules' schedule, when due, then a 48-hour notice is sent first (YX-SEC-35).

title: Step 6+ · Lifecycle, modules and global readiness
Rehire on the same employee record
story: As an HR admin, I want a returning employee to get a new employment on their old record so that history and PAN stay one.
acceptance: Given an ex-employee, when rehired, then a new employment with rehire_of is opened on the existing record (YX-ORG-19).
Given the five rehire options, when the form opens, then company defaults are pre-filled and can be changed (YX-ORG-19).
Given the options, when previewed, then the impact shows before confirmation (YX-ORG-19).

title: Contract end, extension, conversion and retirement changes
story: As an HR admin, I want contract ends and retirement extensions as dated changes so that people never fall off by mistake.
acceptance: Given fixed-term, intern or apprentice employment, when created, then contract_end_on is required (YX-ORG-20).
Given an extension or conversion to permanent, when approved, then it is a dated change that moves the end date or type (YX-HIS-15).
Given a conversion, when effective, then the new type's statutory defaults apply from that date (YX-HIS-15, YX-ORG-20).
Given retirement extension or re-employment, when made, then it is a dated change (YX-HIS-15).

title: Long absence as a dated status
story: As an HR admin, I want sabbatical, maternity and long leave as a status with an expected return so that pay and tasks follow.
acceptance: Given a long absence, when started, then a dated status with expected return is created by a change (YX-EMP-06, YX-HIS-14).
Given the return, when recorded, then return-to-work tasks fire (YX-EMP-06).
Given the impact preview, when shown, then it lists expected attendance, accrual pause and zero-wage months (YX-HIS-14).

title: Bulk restructure: merge or close an entity
story: As an HR admin, I want one wizard to move everyone when we merge or close an entity so that a restructure is one approval.
acceptance: Given a merge or close, when the wizard runs, then all open employments move with YX-ORG-17 options as editable defaults (YX-ORG-22, YX-EMP-07).
Given the batch, when previewed, then there is one impact preview and one approval (YX-ORG-22).
Given the closing entity, when it still has an open employment or an unlocked last payroll, then it cannot be closed (YX-EMP-07, YX-ORG-04).

title: Annual health check-up
story: As an HR admin, I want eligible workers listed each year for a free health check-up so that we follow the OSH Code.
acceptance: Given P07 IN.OSH rules, when the yearly job runs, then eligible workers per establishment are listed and get a scheduling task (YX-EMP-13).
Given outcomes and reports, when stored, then they are Special class; the manager sees only scheduled / done (YX-EMP-13).
Given the check-up, when paid, then nothing is charged to the employee (YX-EMP-13).

title: External login catalogue
story: As a company admin, I want every outside login (candidate, alumni, trainer, vendor) to follow one catalogue so that none gets more than its own records.
acceptance: Given an external login, when created, then it uses a catalogued template with sign-in method, assurance, data classes, portal and end trigger (YX-SEC-33).
Given its grant, when checked, then it covers named records only and is not a billed seat (YX-SEC-21).
Given the end trigger, when reached, then the login expires; every sign-in and view is audited (YX-SEC-21).
Given templates reaching others' Special data, when used, then AAL2 is required (YX-SEC-33).

title: API keys as service grants
story: As a company admin, I want each API key limited to a scope and field classes so that an integration reads only what it needs.
acceptance: Given a key, when created, then it has a scope and an explicit list of allowed field classes (YX-SEC-22).
Given a field class not listed, when the API answers, then that field is redacted (YX-SEC-22).
Given each call, when made, then it is audited under the key's name; keys expire and can be revoked (YX-SEC-22).

title: Test takers see only their own attempts
story: As an employee taking a training test, I want only me to see my attempts and results so that my scores stay private.
acceptance: Given a training or skills test, when I open results, then I see only my own attempts (YX-SEC-26).
Given evaluators and L&D, when they open attempts, then only those in their P02 scope show (YX-SEC-26).
Given test results, when classed, then they are Confidential (YX-SEC-26).

title: New manager reads the current review cycle
story: As a new manager mid-cycle, I want to read my new report's current-cycle reviews and goals so that I can rate them fairly.
acceptance: Given a manager change during an open cycle, when the new manager opens the review, then the whole cycle's review, goals, check-ins and PIP are readable (YX-SEC-24).
Given the old manager's private 1-on-1 notes, when the new manager looks, then they are not shown (YX-SEC-24).
Given the cycle closes, when the next cycle starts, then normal period-bound visibility applies again (YX-SEC-06).

title: Positions
story: As an HR admin, I want positions separate from people so that vacancies and budgets are visible.
acceptance: Given position-based mode, when an assignment is saved, then it must reference a position of the same entity (YX-EMP-09).
Given a position, when incumbents' FTE would exceed its FTE, then it is refused (YX-EMP-09).
Given job-based mode (starter), when used, then positions are optional and nothing is blocked (YX-EMP-09).
Given a vacant position, when 'Open requisition' is clicked, then an M10 requisition is linked to it (YX-EMP-09).

title: Workforce-planning scenarios
story: As an HR head, I want to try hiring and cost scenarios without touching live data so that we can plan the year.
acceptance: Given a scenario, when edited, then live data never changes (YX-EMP-10).
Given the forecast, when computed, then it uses headcount, cost, attrition rate per department and backfill lag (YX-EMP-10).
Given an approved scenario, when approved, then it creates positions or plan lines; scenarios are Confidential (YX-EMP-10).

title: Show career paths and IDPs from M06 on the record
story: As an employee, I want to see my career path and development plan from my profile so that I know my next step.
acceptance: Given Me › Career, when opened, then it shows M06 career paths and IDP without a copy in M01 (YX-EMP-11).
Given workforce scenarios, when computed, then they use only the aggregate attrition rate, never an individual risk band (YX-EMP-12).
Given the succession view, when opened, then the IDP and talent-pool links come from M06 (YX-EMP-11).

title: Data residency per region and region moves
story: As a company admin in the UAE, I want our entity's data kept in-country so that we follow local law.
acceptance: Given an entity's data region, when data is stored, then records, files, backups and indexes stay there (YX-SEC-37).
Given a multi-region company, when the home region reads another region, then only the directory card is copied; Special data never leaves (YX-SEC-37).
Given a region move, when requested, then it needs a legal basis, YukthiX approval, updated DPA and notices, and gives a deletion certificate (YX-SEC-38).

title: IP allow-lists may include the mobile app and portals
story: As a company admin, I want to choose whether our IP allow-lists also apply to the mobile app and external portals so that strict sites can lock everything down.
acceptance: Given the option off (default), when the mobile app or a portal signs in, then the allow-list is not applied (YX-IAM-09).
Given the option on, when a mobile or portal request comes from outside the list, then it is refused (YX-IAM-09).
Given the setting changes, when saved, then it needs step-up and is logged (YX-IAM-02, YX-IAM-10).
